phrase.zh: 在云间，记住人与人的牵挂。
phrase.en: Above the clouds, remember the bonds below.

visual.zh: 为《Wings》独立创作的早期航空拼贴；双翼飞机、螺旋桨与仪表围绕安静的黑色中心。不是电影剧照或海报。
visual.en: An original early-aviation collage made for Wings: a biplane, propeller and instrument surround a quiet black center. Not a movie still or poster.

background.zh:
《Wings》是一部以第一次世界大战飞行为背景的默片，讲述两位飞行员以及他们与留在家乡的女孩之间的关系。画面用机翼、牵索与布条表达飞行、危险和牵挂；这是艺术解读，不重现某个具体镜头。
第1届奥斯卡最佳影片：Wings。颁奖年份 1929；参评年份 1927/28。
background.en:
Wings is a silent drama set amid First World War aviation, following two pilots and their relationships with a woman left at home. Wings, rigging and tied cloth evoke flight, danger and personal bonds; this is an artistic interpretation, not a recreation of a specific shot.
Academy Awards ceremony 1 (1929), Best Picture: Wings. Eligibility year: 1927/28.
